ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 ratio of high-intensity (>200 RGB) to low-intensity (<50 RGB) pixels. High intensity is concentrated in central lobe quadrants; low intensity is concentrated at the peduncle base and peripheral edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white central fields (bilateral) bounded by a continuous black perimeter. Dark, high-contrast striations radiate from the axial peduncle insertion point toward the mid-lobe regions in a fan-like distribution.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Symmetrical V-notch with an approximate 55-degree vertex angle; notch depth comprises roughly 12% of the total vertical pixel span of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency, moderate-amplitude irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge. High-contrast jaggedness is visible on the extreme right distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edge curvature transitioning to a steep upward-sweeping concavity at the distal lobe terminals.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatially distinct clusters of roughly circular, high-intensity pixel groups (barnacles) located on the extreme distal tips of both lobes; approximately 5-8 units per tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the white pigmentation. Left lobe exhibits parallel diagonal lines; right lobe exhibits multi-directional intersecting vertical and oblique lines.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear scarring across the ventral surface of both lobes. Presence of clustered biological growth on distal tips. Minor structural irregularity on the right lobe's outer trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct feathered transition of dark pigment extending from the median notch into the central high-intensity ventral fields.
